item.title: Mick Thomson on Slipknot’s First Album: “My Solos Were Cut”
item.description: Slipknot’s first album is a maelstrom of riffs, rage, and pure chaos, but here’s a tidbit you might’ve missed: not a single guitar solo survived the final cut.
